title: Jamf Pro to Microsoft Intune Migration for Apple Devices — macOS, iPadOS & iOS/iPhone (ABM Re-Assignment, ADE Re-Enrollment, VPP & Profile Cutover)
author_notes: Pricing: T5 program tier (new model) — matches the Workspace ONE umbrella program WS1PROG ($1499); this covers ALL THREE Apple platforms in one program. Commercial $1499, NPO 899.40, Gov 1274.15.

Customer request: build a Jamf Pro -> Intune migration for all Apple device types (macOS, iPadOS, iOS/iPhone). NET-NEW: catalog had WS1->Intune suite + JAMFADE (Jamf+Intune ADE co-existence) but NO off-Jamf migration.

Core realities authored: ONE MDM per Apple device (no dual-MDM). ABM is the pivot — re-assign devices from the Jamf MDM server to the Intune ADE token. Supervised/ADE migration REQUIRES a wipe (erase -> Setup Assistant -> auto-enroll); BYOD/user-enrolled = unenroll/re-enroll, no wipe. VPP licenses bound to the assigning MDM (revoke in Jamf, re-assign in Intune). macOS: FileVault re-escrow, Jamf Connect->Platform SSO/Enterprise SSO, packages->Intune apps/scripts, Defender re-onboard. iOS: SCEP/PKCS re-issue, restrictions/Wi-Fi/per-app VPN/kiosk rebuilt.

Wave-based program: Assess (inventory Jamf + confirm ABM/VPP/ADE) -> Build target per platform -> Pilot wave -> Production waves -> Decommission Jamf. Keep Jamf live for un-migrated devices; supervised rollback = another wipe.
gov_variant false: ABM+Intune supported in GCC High/DoD, mechanics identical; portals intune.microsoft.us/endpoint.microsoft.us noted inline.
Scoped to the migration; defers generic MDM readiness to MDMRDY and steady-state macOS/iOS config to the Intune baseline products.
